Hero_Desc_Uros:
A serpent Beastfolk who was once a hero, but fell and sought to devour the world.
Beyond overwhelming force, she possesses cunning capable of deceiving gods and willpower sufficient to oppose them.
Though her ambition was broken, her deeds remain legendary within the memories of some.
Album_Hate_Uros: Those who stray from the proper path
Album_Wish_Uros: To complete the path she has chosen
Album_Uros1: Through an unexpected awakening, Suro assumed the form of the legendary Uros. Her appearance seems cold to anyone who sees it, but within she remains Suro: warm-hearted, loyal, and dependable.
Album_Uros2: Having assumed Uros's form, Suro regards proving herself as both trial and duty. She is the same as the Uros of the past yet a different being, and is determined to prove herself through her deeds rather than be judged by her appearance.
Album_Uros3: Suro appears to have accepted herself as Uros. Though she has become a figure hated by many races, she will no longer waver over her identity and has resolved to walk her own path to its end. She now embraces even Uros's sins and atones for every past wrong.
Album_Uros4: As Uros, Suro has become calmer than she was in her original appearance. She seems more mature overall, though playful conversation occasionally draws out Suro's former energetic and mischievous personality. Her nature remains unchanged despite her appearance.
Album_Uros5: Wishing to atone for Uros's past, Suro established an organization called White Snake Hall. It is a volunteer group serving the residents of Elias, and both Ran and Epica belong to it. Seeing these three, whose pasts are so chaotically intertwined, work together is both ironic and remarkable.
Album_Uros6: Suro says that as Uros, she sometimes witnesses the experiences of the former Uros through dreams. She was confused at first, but advice and counseling from those around her have helped turn the dreams into a means of understanding Uros's past actions.
Album_Uros7: Even as Uros, Suro still practices swordsmanship frequently with Tig. Merely watching their dramatically improved duel is thrilling. When I asked who was stronger, Suro said they were evenly matched, though as before, she believed herself superior in technique.

Food_ChefNote_Uros_Hate1: Even after becoming Uros, her difficulty digesting this remains unchanged. Believing her stronger body must have improved her digestion, she pushed herself too far and developed a stomachache.
Food_ChefNote_Uros_Hate2: Though it was not to her taste, she said she could not leave food served to her and forced it down in one bite with her eyes closed. Since it is a one-bite wrap, perhaps that counts as success...
Food_ChefNote_Uros_Like1: Only now does Suro reveal that while wandering outside the Order, she wanted grilled cartoon meat so badly that she visited the banquet hall in her dreams.
Food_ChefNote_Uros_Like2: Apparently, this food always pleases her. While wandering, she developed the habit of keeping feed in her pocket and chewing one piece at a time as she walked.
Food_ChefNote_Uros_Like3: She said she wanted to continue eating even if it made her older. Only after five bowls did she hum with a satisfied expression.
Food_ChefNote_Uros_Like4: Fascinated by the log shape, she examined it from every direction before eating happily. She even licked the plate clean, making the effort of serving her worthwhile.
Food_ChefNote_Uros_Like5: Only halfway through did an idea occur to her. She asked whether I could store the remainder so she might later sprinkle it over grilled cartoon meat.
Food_ChefNote_Uros_Like6: She liked that its contents could not be determined from its appearance. She described it as food rather like herself.
Food_ChefNote_Uros_Like7: She said it would be perfect whenever sword training left her in need of sugar. Then she licked her lips and added that it was delicious at any time.
Food_ChefNote_Uros_Like8: I told her Yum-Yum Vita tasted best when eaten with loud 'yum-yum' sounds. She did exactly that, then puffed out her cheeks when she realized I had fooled her.
Food_ChefNote_Uros_Like9: She proudly promised to demonstrate the feat of identifying flavors with her eyes closed. In the end, she succeeded about half the time.

LoveLetter_Uros:
I trust you have been well, Master.

I find myself uncertain from the very beginning of this letter. Somehow, I feel I should still sign my name to you as 'Suro.' I can sense it immediately: even though my appearance has changed, your gaze still reflects the young wandering serpent Beastfolk.

Ah, I am not displeased! On the contrary, your unwavering regard feels indescribably warm, and I am only grateful. I shall live with your constant care engraved upon my heart.

I shall write again soon.
LoveCall_Uros:
Master, this is Uros. May we speak for a moment?
Whew... Hearing your voice reassures me.

Ah, nothing has happened. I merely had a nightmare for the first time in a very long while.
Yet both within the dream and after I awoke... you were the first person to enter my thoughts.
Forgive me for calling with such urgency.
I am not ordinarily a Beastfolk who depends upon others this way... It seems I rely upon you greatly.
Ah, I may call comfortably at any time? R-Really? Thank you, Master. Hehe...

If circumstances permitted, I would always remain beside you and serve you...
For now, I shall be content that we can live as good friends.

Thank you for guiding me onto the proper path, always treating me with care... and regarding me with the same constancy at all times, Master.
Then I shall call again tomorrow.
